# Browser player

`hls-1.7.4.min.js` is the unmodified full build of [hls.js 1.7.4](https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/releases/tag/v1.7.4), retrieved from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.7.4/dist/hls.min.js.

License: Apache-2.0. Upstream copyright and derived-work notices are retained in `hls-LICENSE`; the full license is in `Apache-2.0.txt`. Served locally; no runtime CDN dependency or Node.js service is required.
